name: layout_qr_links
description: Stable public QR link of one layout area. The last authorized publication sets its public HTTPS destination; saving a draft does not activate it.
lifecycle: Created or updated in the publication transaction through the Programming port. Identity and tenant remain immutable. Deleting the layout cascades its public links.

columns.Meaning: Opaque stable 128-bit identifier derived from the layout identity and area key; public short-link identity, not API authorization.
Company owning the layout and link; immutable tenant key.
Owning layout UUID; immutable, with a tenant-safe composite foreign key.
Public HTTPS destination approved by the most recent publication of this layout area; no URL credentials.
PostgreSQL-clock instant at which publication last advanced the destination.

constraints.Purpose: One stable link per company, layout and area key.
Tenant-safe identity key, consistent with every company-owned table.
The same short lowercase area identifier used by layouts.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, layout_id) REFERENCES layouts(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: Tenant-safe owning layout; deletion cascades its links.
Public HTTPS destination; application validation also refuses credentials and nonstandard ports.
